channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Mad Games Tycoon 2
item.description: Start your own game development studio in 1976. Build your own offices, production facilities and server rooms. Develop the games of your dreams and produce the next next-gen console. Rise from a small garage company to a huge corporation.

item.title: Melvor Idle: Atlas of Discovery
item.description: Atlas of Discovery, Melvor Idle’s second expansion, is all about exploration! Discover eight new Combat Areas packed with dozens of monsters to fight and hundreds of new items to find. Unlock two new exploration skills, try the all-new Ancient Relics Gamemode… and more!

item.title: Melvor Idle: Into the Abyss
item.description: Discover a new dimension to Melvor Idle as you descend into the Abyssal Realm! Encounter new challenges, unique environments and mechanics while mastering new Abyssal Skills. As you delve deeper, the stakes get higher… but will you rise to glory?

item.title: Melvor Idle: Throne of the Herald
item.description: Throne of the Herald expansion continues the story of our hero as you discover more about the mystic forces that surround the lands of Melvor, and the dark forces that remain hidden outside of the Capital. New locations to explore, new gear to craft, and even more monsters to fight!

item.title: Styx: Blades of Greed
item.description: The master of stealth is back! Explore the dizzying heights of the Iserian Continent and cunningly eliminate your enemies. Thanks to your Quartz powers, you are freer than ever. Be creative: Never has it felt so good to be greedy.

item.title: Internet Survivor Survivors
item.description: A top-down action roguelite Touhou fangame featuring Flan, who's... started streaming and has taken the internet by storm!? Collect likes and coins to power up your weapons! Your very viewer count becomes your life! Annihilate the constant hordes of enemies and survive, survive, SURVIVE!

item.title: Melvor Idle
item.description: Inspired by RuneScape, Melvor Idle takes the core of what makes an adventure game so addictive and strips it down to its purest form! This is a feature-rich, idle/incremental game combining a distinctly familiar feel with a fresh gameplay experience. Maxing 20+ skills has never been more zen.

item.title: Sally Face - Episode One
item.description: An unsettling adventure following a boy with a prosthetic face. After a string of mysterious murders, Sal and his three friends discover something truly sinister casting shadows over their small town.

item.title: Sally Face - Season Pass
item.description: Sally Face Episodes 2 - 5. Plus the Sally Face Original Soundtrack.

item.title: A Total War Saga: TROY - MYTHOS
item.description: The battle for Troy cannot be waged by man alone. In this big, bold Expansion Pack, recruit monsters and creatures of myth to fight at your side, turning the tide of war on new fantastical battlefields and a refreshed campaign map.

item.title: Axon TD: Uprising - Tower Defense
item.description: Axon TD lets you expand the map boundaries themselves. A huge arsenal of towers and a wide variety of enemies clash in a battlefield that grows to your whims. Engage in single, cooperative, and roguelite gameplay.

item.title: OFF
item.description: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.

item.title: Placid Plastic Deck - A Quiet Quest
item.description: A story-driven adventure featuring card battles, multiple-choice dialogue, and funny characters! A friendship to mend, and a cast of opponents to beat, each with a uniquely built deck. But you're in luck… yours is all ducks!

item.title: YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story
item.description: YOU and ME and HER: A Love Story is the visual novel medium in its purest form. Will Shinichi choose Miyuki, the beautiful queen bee of the school, or the endearingly awkward misfit Aoi? With art by Tsuji Santa, these beautifully rendered romances will stay with you forever.

item.title: Deponia
item.description: In Deponia, the world has degenerated into a vast garbage dump, in which the crotchety Rufus ekes out his sorry existence.
